svg.text: THE ORCHESTRATOR — one round, five phases
final class · round state machine · the god object
every public method asserts its phase, then advances it ✓
no locks — a table is one thread; parallelism = many tables
player(name, bet) · build() — validates once, then frozen
DIP — the loop runs the same on 1 Deck or a 6-deck Shoe
STRATEGY — the house draw rule, S17 vs H17
called in a loop until it says stop
dealer stands pat entirely if every player already busted
it prices an Outcome; it never decides the Outcome
private ctor ⇒ you cannot hand-build an invalid deck ✓
seed lives at the factory ⇒ same seed, same deal
deals by cursor, never removes from the list
same interface as Deck ⇒ orchestrator unchanged
it only FLAGS the reshuffle — nobody reshuffles it here
one boolean apart — exactly why it is a Strategy ✓
ratios as basis points ⇒ integer money, no float drift
returns NET payout, not the gross return
THE MODEL — cards, hands, seats, results
the only class with real logic
not a persistent account — one round only
one per seat, in seat order

g.text: Sum every card with Ace = 1 → the
HARD total. Then promote ONE ace
so at most ONE ace is ever soft.
Never varies → keep it in code:

svg.text: ① Blackjack orchestrator + RoundState guard → ② the three seams (CardSource / DealerStrategy / PayoutStrategy) → ③ impls (Deck · Shoe · S17/H17 · 3:2/6:5) → ④ model (Hand is where the Ace logic lives)

g.text: Patterns: State machine (enum) · Strategy ×2 · Factory method · Builder · DIP
One round of casino Blackjack — seeded, reproducible, single-threaded — LLD
